Fitted so the five Kelvin presets of the body's own files (2500, 3200, 4500, 6000, 8500 K) read at their labels on the A7R IV locus (least squares in log chroma). The scale the body's published colour matrix at D65 gives (matrix_scale) leaves a mean preset angle of 2.07 degrees and reads the Daylight preset at 4720 K, outside the limits of docs/03 (at most 2 degrees, Daylight 5000 to 5600 K), so the presets set the scale.

Takes the scale of the Sony A1: the published colour matrices of the two bodies agree (largest per-coefficient difference 0.0000, limit 0.02). No file of this body was available, so the presets were not read.
